notes: Single deliverable pair: a headless vim macro script and its computed outputs. Difficulty sits in composing exact vim substitution/macro keystrokes that (a) match the strict row shape (lowercase level, zero-padded date, no '|' in message) without touching near-miss rows byte-for-byte, (b) uppercase a captured field inside the replacement, and (c) support both no-arg (glob the feeds dir) and explicit-argument invocation for hidden re-runs. Byte-exact row fidelity gives a sharp pass/fail edge; medium difficulty.
